I answered Pree in a thread in #central-random: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in that channel yesterday at 09:27. He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841.

His message calls it "Tobias's dealer account" and never names Marrow Fieldworks. I linked the two using a public Central handoff digest from January. It describes Marrow Fieldworks as Pree's dealer account, handed over on 5 Jan. So I suggested Pree check with Tobias before the call to be sure. I also warned her not to mix it up with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging ticket.

I only used channels Pree is in and files anyone can open. Nothing in the answer needed approval.
